messages:
maria: Customer reported large invoice delta for acct acme-123 after using streaming API. Dashboard shows ~12k tokens for the day, invoice charged ~42k. Customer insists they didn’t send that many prompts. They’re using SSE streaming and reported a client reconnect during a long generation.

kevin: Can you paste sample request IDs / server logs? Did the client abort midstream or issue a soft cancel?

maria: Pasting redacted server log snippet from their tenant (request id r_9f8a):
```
[2026-03-09T14:02:15Z] r_9f8a SSE open
[2026-03-09T14:02:16Z] r_9f8a chunk sent tokens=340 seq=1
[2026-03-09T14:02:16Z] r_9f8a chunk sent tokens=410 seq=2
[2026-03-09T14:02:17Z] r_9f8a client connection lost (ECONNRESET)
[2026-03-09T14:02:17Z] r_9f8a retry layer reissued request with id r_9f8a-1
[2026-03-09T14:02:18Z] r_9f8a-1 chunk sent tokens=340 seq=1
[2026-03-09T14:02:19Z] r_9f8a-1 final chunk sent tokens=220 seq=final
[2026-03-09T14:02:19Z] r_9f8a finalization event recorded
[2026-03-09T14:02:20Z] r_9f8a-1 finalization event recorded (duplicate)
```

maria: Customer also provided the raw SSE frames captured at the client: they see two `event: done` frames after reconnect.

jen: This looks like a duplicate-finalization symptom — billing pipeline is counting per-chunk tokens and also counting the finalization record. If a reconnect causes the runtime to emit a final chunk again, our metering aggregator may double-count.

kevin: I’ll try to repro. Quick repro steps for anyone trying locally:
```bash
# start a server that streams tokens (dev runtime)
python stream_server.py --port 8080 &
# connect with curl and then kill the connection to simulate client reset
curl -N http://localhost:8080/v1/generate?stream=true -H "Authorization: Bearer tok" > /dev/null &
sleep 1; kill -9 $!  # abrupt disconnect
# reconnect immediately
curl -N http://localhost:8080/v1/generate?stream=true -H "Authorization: Bearer tok"
```
kevin: With that pattern I reproduced +2x final token event in our dev meter. Root cause looks like billing finalizer job merges chunk counts and finalization token sums without de-dup key.

alex: Action items: (1) eng-runtime to add an idempotency token on finalization events (kevin) (2) billing to add a short-window dedupe for finalization records (jen) (3) support to notify customer with provisional credit if confirmed (maria).

billing-bot: Invoice delta flagged: acct=acme-123 delta=+30,112 tokens invoice=INV-7943 priority=high

kevin: Proposed quick fix: attach `finalization_id` derived from model-run-id + client-session-id. In the billing stream, ignore duplicates with same finalization_id within 10s. Will open PR with unit test.

jen: Forensics query to find potentially-affected invoices (run in analytics):
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, acct, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, COUNT(DISTINCT finalization_id) AS finals
FROM billing_events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-10'
  AND stream=true
GROUP BY invoice_id, acct
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT finalization_id) < COUNT(*) - 1; -- heuristic for duplicate finals
```

maria: Customer asked for ETA and potential rollback. Recommend provisional credit while eng confirms. I’ll inform them: "We’re investigating — we may issue an interim credit while we patch and verify for affected invoices." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: Opening PR now and will include a migration to drop duplicate finalization records from last 30 days. Will post PR link when ready.

alex: Also add a dashboard alert: streaming finalization spikes > 5x baseline in 5m window -> paging.

maria: Thanks all — I’ll follow up with the customer once we have confirmation (cc @finance).
